ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 40% high-intensity pixels (white) concentrated at the lateral tips and 60% low-intensity pixels (dark grey/black) concentrated in the medial and basal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white blobs located at the distal extremities of both lobes. Left lobe exhibits a white patch spanning roughly 25% of its visible surface. Right lobe exhibits a more elongated white patch along the superior-lateral edge. Mottled transition zone with high-frequency dark speckling occurs at the interface of white and black regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an estimated interior angle of 45-50 degrees; notch depth is approximately 1/6th of the total vertical fluke height visible above the waterline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge. Right lobe displays larger amplitude jagged peaks (5-12 pixels) compared to the left lobe. The edge displays a 'saw-tooth' profile with approximately 15-20 distinct peaks per lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory originating from the median notch, transitioning to a sharper upward sweep at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of dark, roughly circular pixel groups (diameter <10 pixels) visible against the white pigment on the distal-lateral edge of the right lobe and scattered along the left lobe tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct parallel dark linear streaks visible on the white region of the left lobe, oriented roughly horizontally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant irregular indentation/notching on the right lobe immediately adjacent to the median notch, showing a loss of linear continuity compared to the left side.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced white fringe/bordering along the extreme trailing edge of the right lobe where the serration is most prominent.
